value.rationale: The exact topology threshold and universal sharp limit for the optimally achievable benefit of resetting in a natural quantum/metric-graph-free Brownian search geometry quantify a meaningful branching tradeoff; an exact constant and monotone all-degree result go beyond routine one-case Laplace evaluation.
residual_risks: Specific only to identical arms, one absorbing and all other reflecting tips, and hub reset.

final_claim: For an equilateral metric Brownian star with one absorbing terminal, the other m-1 reflecting, and Poisson hub resetting, resetting improves the mean absorption time iff m>=2; the optimal fraction saved increases strictly with m and tends to the sharp 0.1447363448.. bound defined by a unique positive hyperbolic equation root.
limitations: No new claim for the classical restart identity; exact boundary-value and monotonic all-degree conclusions are the contribution.
